mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 7.5% triggers immediate equity selling pressure from labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 indicates strong manufacturing output that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index above 230.0 indicates inflationary pressure that prompts central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 750.0 thousand units signals weak residential construction that reduces consumer wealth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 750.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
